content.title: American Bitcoin steadies after share lock-up expiry sparks near 40% plunge
content.summary: Shares of American Bitcoin, a bitcoin miner backed by two of U.S. President Donald Trump's sons, steadied ​on Wednesday, a day after slumping nearly 40% following the ‌expiry of a share lock-up.  American Bitcoin, a majority-owned subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp, is one of the several crypto ventures linked to the Trump family that ⁠began trading on the Nasdaq ‌in September following a reverse merger with Gryphon Digital Mining.  Eric Trump serves as the company's co-founder and chief ‍strategy officer, while Donald Trump Jr. is a shareholder.
